case_number: 2024 INSC 1002; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 1766 OF 2009, CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 6703-6710 OF 2009

parties.respondent: M/s. Madhan Agro Industries (India) Private Ltd.

summary: Classification of coconut oil in small packages (5 ml-2L) as edible oil (Heading 1513) vs hair oil (Heading 3305); tariff amendment effect from 2005; statutory interpretation of Chapter Notes; earlier circulars (1995) held irrelevant post-amendment; plain language of amended headings dispositive; pure coconut oil classified as edible oil regardless of packaging size; duty rate comparison (8% vs 16%) noted; revenue implications ~₹159 crore; bench opinion reconciled by holding packaging irrelevant for pure coconut oil classification.
legal_provisions_cited: First Schedule to Central Excise Tariff Act, 1985 Chapter 15
First Schedule to Central Excise Tariff Act, 1985 Chapter 33
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; classification as edible oil under Heading 1513 confirmed; revenue entitled to duty at 8% rate.
